title: Approval of the Second Amendment to Lease LAA-9126 with HNTB Corporation: To expand the premises and extend the term, covering office space in the Los Angeles World Airports-owned Skyview Center, loca
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Second Amendment to Lease LAA-9126 with HNTB Corporation: To expand the premises and extend the term, covering office space in the Los Angeles World Airports-owned Skyview Center, located at 6033 West Century Boulevard, for approximately $3,196,105 in net revenue over the term; and appropriation of $544,110 for tenant improvements and $201,732.02 for broker commissions (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Second amendment to HNTB Corporation's lease at Skyview Center, 6033 West Century Boulevard, expanding its office space and extending the term, with about $3.2 million in net revenue to the airport plus appropriations for tenant improvements and broker commissions.

locations.text: 6033 West Century Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA
